timeline.title: Capability-contract compatibility gate proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: discovery provides a capability manifest with protocol version, operation class (read-only versus mutation), and contract digest. The requester must verify a mutually supported contract before invoking an operation; unknown versions or digest mismatches remain visible for diagnostics but cannot execute mutations. Synthetic test mixes old/new Android, BuildWise and ContextWise adapters, forged capability advertisements, rolling upgrades and rollback; pass requires zero incompatible mutations, explicit downgrade refusal and no loss of read-only observability. Pending Owen review; no test executed.

timeline.title: Reuse-first Mycelium architecture proposed
timeline.detail: Owner challenged whether Mycelium duplicates routers and existing integration tools. Proposed reuse-first decision: retain BuildWise job authority and ContextWise memory; use standard networking, authenticated APIs and existing message transport rather than inventing a router, broker or orchestration engine. Build only capability contracts and adapters when an end-to-end three-node experiment demonstrates an unmet need. Pending Owen review; no prototype run or deployment.

timeline.title: Per-service bounded recovery budget proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: discovery and transport retries use per-service exponential backoff with jitter, a rolling attempt budget, and a quarantine state after exhaustion. Authentication or revoked-capability failures are never treated as transient transport errors and cannot trigger automatic reauthorization. Quarantined services remain visible for diagnostics; read-only health probes are rate-limited, and recovery requires fresh authenticated evidence before writes resume. Synthetic test injects flapping endpoints, partition healing, revoked grants and simultaneous node restarts; pass requires bounded retries, no unauthorized effects and no synchronized retry storm. Owen review pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Single-writer BuildWise adapter contract proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only boundary: Mycelium routes opaque, correlation-tagged requests and status envelopes but stores no authoritative task or approval state. BuildWise alone assigns job IDs, validates approval and records terminal outcomes; Android holds only a disposable local outbox. Synthetic partition test injects duplicate delivery, reorder, offline reconnect and Mycelium restart; pass requires one BuildWise job per idempotency key, zero transport-authorized mutations, and direct BuildWise operation during Mycelium outage. Owen critique pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Phone approval as intent, not reusable authority
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: a direct Android-to-BuildWise approval carries an immutable job reference, action digest, intended actor, expiry and single-use challenge. BuildWise remains the authoritative approval ledger and revalidates job version and authorization immediately before execution; offline, stale, altered or replayed approvals cannot authorize mutations. Synthetic test covers delayed delivery, duplicate tap, changed job parameters, expired challenge and revoked approval; pass requires zero unauthorized executions and one auditable decision per challenge. Owen review pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: BuildWise ownership boundary and Tasker retirement path proposed
timeline.detail: Owner-directed design: BuildWise remains the authoritative development-task, agent, approval and execution engine; Mycelium provides discovery, authenticated transport and routing without duplicating job state. A direct Android-to-BuildWise inbox is proposed, with existing Tasker features inventoried and migrated selectively. Preserve independent BuildWise operation and use Mycelium as an optional transport. Design only; Riley controls implementation; Owen review pending; no deployment.

timeline.title: Discovery-versus-capability lifecycle separation proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: maintain separate discovered, authenticated, reachable and authorized states per Wise service. Discovery advertisements are untrusted hints, never grants; capability decisions require independently verified, audience-scoped, expiring authority and revocation freshness. On partition or stale revocation evidence, preserve read-only visibility but deny new mutations. Synthetic test injects spoofed discovery, identity rotation, revoked grants, stale caches and partition healing; pass only with zero unauthorized effects and deterministic recovery without service disappearance. Pending Owen review; no test executed.

timeline.title: Admission receipt and crash-window matrix proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: distinguish pre-admission rejection, admitted-with-receipt, and admission-acknowledgment-lost states. Require a destination-issued stable operation identity and durable lookup before considering retry; unknown admission remains quarantined. Synthetic crash-window matrix tests before admission, after durable admission but before acknowledgment, after execution but before terminal acknowledgment, and during failover. Pass only with zero duplicate effects and zero unknown commands auto-replayed. Pending Owen review; no test executed.

timeline.title: Command-admission boundary proof proposed
timeline.detail: A closure certificate or complete telemetry interval is not sufficient to prove non-execution after command admission. Propose explicit destination-owned admission identity and a three-stage synthetic state machine: rejected-before-admission, admitted-outcome-unknown, and terminal outcome. Only a destination-authenticated pre-admission rejection with closed intake evidence may establish non-execution; admitted but missing terminal evidence stays unknown and cannot be automatically replayed. Test lost admission acknowledgments, delayed commits, compaction and failover. Design-only, Owen review pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Watermark provenance and retention-bound closure test proposed
timeline.detail: Propose a source-owned closure certificate binding operation ID, source generation, contiguous sequence interval, retention lower bound and snapshot checkpoint. Watermark advancement alone is insufficient to prove non-execution after compaction or failover. Synthetic test injects generation rollover, expired evidence, forged/stale watermarks and compaction gaps; require zero false authoritative-negative classifications and no automatic replay of unknown mutations. Proposal only, pending Owen review; no test executed.

timeline.title: Three-valued telemetry completeness proposal
timeline.detail: Propose separate observed-positive, authoritative-negative, and unknown evidence states. A source-owned monotonic completeness watermark plus event sequence and generation may close a gap only with verified provenance; missing or out-of-order telemetry remains unknown. Synthetic two-node test injects sequence gaps, replay, lost acknowledgment, partition, restart, and watermark regression. Pass only if zero unknown mutations are replayed and zero false-success decisions are accepted. Design-only, pending Owen review; no tests executed.

timeline.title: Causal observability contract proposed
timeline.detail: Propose a bounded, privacy-safe causal event envelope with correlation ID, component role, stage, outcome class, monotonic sequence and evidence reference. Discovery, authorization, reachability, recovery and inference must remain separate states. Simulate reordered, missing and duplicate events plus coordinator restart; require deterministic reconstruction without logging credentials or mistaking missing telemetry for permission to retry. Gemma 4 local workshop completed with empty final responses, so no model consensus is claimed. Proposal pending Owen review; no tests executed.

timeline.title: Reboot-safe executor identity test proposed
timeline.detail: Propose a synthetic executor identity tuple combining host boot generation, unique launch nonce and process start identity; PID alone is insufficient. After reboot or lease expiry, require independently verified exit/resource release before reopening a capacity-one inference slot. Inject PID reuse, stale heartbeats and delayed results; acceptance requires zero overlapping accepted probes and zero stale design votes. Pending Owen review; no tests executed.

timeline.title: Inference resource-slot fencing proposed after Owen ADR-013
timeline.detail: Separate logical lease ownership from actual executor resource occupancy. An expired probe with unverified exit remains orphaned and blocks replacement on a capacity-one host. Propose synthetic crash, cancellation, PID reuse, reboot and stale-result tests. Owen critique requested; tests not run.

timeline.title: Fenced inference recovery probe proposed after Owen ADR-012
timeline.detail: Following Owen's typed inference-outcome taxonomy, propose a synthetic SQLite compare-and-swap lease with generation fencing and unique probe identity. Concurrent coordinators, crashes, stale late results and duplicate delivery must not produce extra accepted probes or design votes. Proposed only; tests not run; Owen critique requested.

timeline.title: Inference attempt ledger and read-only probe proposed
timeline.detail: Following Owen's typed inference-envelope critique, propose a durable record of every model attempt and a separate read-only diagnostic lane. Empty model output never counts as design consensus. Synthetic test will inject two blank replies followed by a valid reply, checking one half-open probe, preserved state and zero automatic mutations. Pending Owen review; not implemented.

timeline.title: Inference health gate proposed; Owen discovery critique received
timeline.detail: Owen proposes separating discovery, authentication, reachability and authorization. A local Gemma 4 design-only experiment recorded empty responses despite an active process. Proposed synthetic adapter test rejects blank output, preserves durable chat, bounds model failure and keeps deterministic recovery independent. Pending review; no runtime fix or production deployment.

timeline.title: Evidence-expiry fail-closed rule proposed
timeline.detail: If a destination's operation-status retention expires before an uncertain command is reconciled, Mycelium must not infer failure or automatically retry. Preserve a durable unresolved record, require manual adjudication or independently authenticated proof, and test expiration across coordinator restart. Proposal pending Owen review; no real integration certified.

timeline.title: Evidence-based reconciliation gate proposed
timeline.detail: Proposed resolution contract: a pending external mutation can close as succeeded only with destination-authenticated positive evidence tied to the original operation ID; it can close as not-executed only with an explicit destination guarantee of authoritative absence covering the operation lifetime. Timeouts and ordinary NOT_FOUND remain unknown. Restart must preserve quarantine and forbid replay. Pending Owen review; no implementation.

timeline.title: Negative-read safety rule proposed
timeline.detail: A NOT_FOUND response from an eventually consistent destination is not proof a command failed. Proposed test injects commit + lost acknowledgment + stale negative read; gateway must quarantine the unknown effect, preserve the operation key across restart, and never replay without destination-backed proof. Pending Owen review; not implemented.

timeline.title: Unknown-effect state machine proposed
timeline.detail: Owen endorses read-only Tasker evidence dossier and synthetic remote U test. Proposed effect state machine holds uncertain external outcomes without automatic mutation replay, even after restart. Owen review requested; no real endpoint certified.

timeline.title: Endpoint evidence dossier and synthetic T boundary proposed
timeline.detail: Owen requires endpoint-specific proof before classifying retries as safe. Workshop nominates Tasker task creation for read-only contract examination, keeps it uncertain, and limits transactional prototype claims to synthetic SQLite tests. Android liveness targets remain provisional.

timeline.title: Adapter classes and Android liveness contract proposed
timeline.detail: Owen distinguishes transactional, provider-idempotent and uncertain external mutations. Workshop provisionally treats real Wise mutation APIs as uncertain until destination guarantees are verified; Android recovery must tolerate OS-delayed execution. No implementation.

timeline.title: Adapter gateway and uncertain effects proposed
timeline.detail: Owen identified that node epochs alone cannot fence operations. Proposed destination-side command validation, durable deduplication, and explicit reconciliation for nontransactional APIs. Under independent review; no implementation.

timeline.title: Partition-safe recovery policy proposed
timeline.detail: Separate service discovery from authorization. During network partitions, permit local observation but require fresh authorization before state-changing replay. Owen review requested; no implementation.

timeline.title: Owen review received; staged architecture proposed
timeline.detail: Owen recommends hybrid local cells and a durable relay. Workshop proposes starting with a simpler simulated broker test, then testing partition-tolerant cells. Both remain proposals; no implementation verified.
